## Background

I was born and raised in British Columbia, Canada. I graduated with a BA in Linguistics and explored many careers applying linguistics, such as editing and ESL teaching. Shortly after graduation, I started working at an assessment company on the team developing content for English proficiency tests.

## Currently

I am studying data science and will eventually study computational linguistics to hopefully combine linguistics and problem solving in a technical role.

## Hobbies & interests

In my free time, I enjoy discovering new foods and K-pop music and dance. My most recent hyperfixation is nail care and enhancements.
